title: Canonical first-residue cohomological comparison
statement: For the canonical maps and realization of [def-sfb-embedded-integral-model-coefficients], constant first reduction after integral scalar restriction has constructible cohomology and finite Tor amplitude if and only if the specified intrinsic realization of continuous first reduction has constructible cohomology in a bounded ordered interval. Assume ell prime, E finite embedded, pi generates its maximal ideal, the first residue finite and discrete, and X Noetherian. There is no completeness or etale-origin assertion.

proof.text: The actual finite constant-to-continuous residue map is an isomorphism, normalized on scalars. The finite derived-reduction comparison for the integral scalar map identifies reduction after restriction with direct continuous reduction, with the specified residue action. Its section-action and constant-scalar realization is the specified canonical functor.
Exactness preserves cohomology. The finite constant local models on every stratum agree with intrinsic finite local models, preserving the finite partition and cohomological vanishing.

Over the residue field all sheaf modules are flat by sectionwise vector-space flatness and flat sheafification. Good truncations and bounded-above flat K-flatness identify bounded cohomology with finite Tor amplitude. Tensor with the unit proves the converse; enlarge to an ordered interval also for zero objects and empty schemes.

theorem embeddedIntegral_residue_comparison
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ)
    (π : PadicAlgCl.integers ℓ E.1)
    (hπ : Ideal.span {π} = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (PadicAlgCl.integers ℓ E.1))
    [Finite (completedResidue ℓ E π 0)] [DiscreteTopology (completedResidue ℓ E π 0)]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    (K : DerivedCategory.{u + 1} (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (integralCoefficientObject X ℓ E))) :
    integralModelConstantResidueCondition X ℓ E π
      ((IntegralModelsEmbedded.restriction.{u} ℓ E X).obj K) ↔
    integralModelIntrinsicBoundedConstructible X (completedResidue ℓ E π 0)
      ((integralModelIntrinsicDerivedRealization.{u} X (completedResidue ℓ E π 0)).obj
        ((integralModelFirstDerivedReduction X ℓ E π).obj K))
